  "answer": "Here is a summary of the emails regarding Project Zenith:

*   **Project Launch & Leadership:** Project Zenith was introduced as a new initiative for data analytics and cloud storage optimization. Initial leadership included Sarah Tan (Analytics) and Marcus Cole. Later, Omar Jensen was identified as the lead developer for the development phase.
*   **Timeline & Phases:** The project kick-off was scheduled for June 15th (with a Q3 2023 start mentioned in one email) and a kickoff meeting on July 15th. The project has progressed through the design phase and testing phase, with the development phase starting the following month. A milestone celebration for the completion of the testing phase was held on October 10th.
*   **Budget:** The initial budget for phase one was $500,000. This was later adjusted to $550,000 to cover unforeseen expenses and real-time analytics integration. Additionally, a separate $15,000 budget was approved for training programs for the coding team and project managers.
*   **Partnerships & Team Expansion:** A strategic partnership was secured with TechInnovate for AI research. The team expanded to include Mike Chen (machine learning) and Lisa Ray (cloud computing).
*   **Note on External Email:** There is an email from "Jenny Harper" regarding "Zenith Innovations" and a "Revolutionary AI Project," which appears to be a separate onboarding communication for an external partner, distinct from the internal Project Zenith updates."
